name: Ap (Apas)
description: Ap (Vedic Sanskrit áp-, plural āpas) is the Vedic Sanskrit word for water and, in Hindu religious tradition, the personified deification of the waters as a group of female deities celebrated in the Rigveda and Atharvaveda.

aliases.name: Āpaḥ
aliases.meaning: Vocative/nominative plural form of the deified waters

aliases.name: Apām Napāt
aliases.meaning: 'Offspring of the waters' — closely related Vedic deity

aliases.name: Āp
aliases.meaning: Modern descendant of the Vedic word for water

regions: Sapta-Sindhu (the historical Vedic homeland in the northwest Indian subcontinent)
origin: The cult of the Apas belongs to the Vedic and broader Hindu religious tradition of the Indian subcontinent. Cognate water-deity traditions exist in the closely related Indo-Iranian (Avestan) religion.
